title: The Heart Inside the Steamed Bun
description: An AI-animated comic-style Chinese microdrama (originally 包子里的真心) built around a small steamed-bun shop's rivalry with a cheaper, corner-cutting competitor — using the shop-war setup as a satire of business honesty versus cheap imitation.
descriptionMore: Done in China's "AI 漫剧" (AI comic-drama) style rather than live action, the series plays its steamed-bun shop rivalry for laughs while making a point about cutting corners versus doing things properly. It became one of the breakout AI-generated microdramas of 2026, reportedly passing 1.3 billion views on Douyin.
